name: Extract invoice fields
description: Sub-workflow: PDF text, daily AI-call cap, Gemini structured extraction. Always returns one record.

parameters.content:
## Extract invoice fields
Input: `idempotency_key`, `message_id`, `attachment_id`, `filename` + binary `invoice_pdf`.
Output: `{ record, extraction_status, error_code }`; `record` follows `code/src/extraction.js`.

1. PDF text via **Extract From File** (no OCR; image-only PDF -> `OCR_REQUIRED`).
2. Reserve one Gemini call in `ai_call_ledger` (atomic, per UTC day of the DB). Cap reached -> `DAILY_AI_CAP_REACHED`, no call.
3. Gemini `generateContent` with a JSON response schema; output checked by `validateOutput`.
Every failure ends in a REVIEW_REQUIRED record, never a guessed value.
Edit **Extraction settings**: Gemini model id and the daily call cap. Credential: "Gemini API" (Google Gemini(PaLM) API type).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ai_call_ledger AS l (call_date, provider, calls)
VALUES (current_date, 'gemini', 1)
ON CONFLICT (call_date, provider)
DO UPDATE SET calls = l.calls + 1, updated_at = now()
WHERE l.calls < $1
RETURNING calls;
